acceptanceCriteria: An optional, closed queue policy field makes ticket create (and refine that clears milestone) refuse a missing milestone with a named code; default behaviour is unchanged.
queue status and roadmap report the count of OPEN tickets with no milestone.
The Tasks spec records the policy field and the count, with tests for refusal, default acceptance and the count.
body:
Observed 2026-10-08 (corvint-tasks with Core 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360): 438 of 546 OPEN tickets had no milestone, so v1.0 scope could not be read from the queue. ticket create accepts milestone null with no warning, and no read reports how many open tickets lack one. The owner asked that every ticket carry a milestone; a one-off backfill does not keep it true.

Expected: a queue can opt in to requiring milestones on create, and reads surface the unmilestoned count so drift is visible.

title: corvint-tasks: optional policy to require a milestone on ticket create, and an unmilestoned count in queue status
